Changes.note: “Save” replaces the nazır’s permissions in this medrese and its courses with the group, the extra permissions, the courses and the end you chose: what stays keeps its giver and date, what you take away goes at once. The nazır can do only what they are given and cannot hand it on. Every permission given or taken away is written to the audit log with the level you give at. At its end a permission lapses by itself; you can undo a change by editing again.
Editor.expiresHelp: Leave empty for no end. The permission lapses by itself at that moment.
Editor.expiresProblems.past: The end must be after the current time.
